title: Define energy

hook.scenario: Aapka phone jab pura charge hota hai, toh wo bahut saare tasks handle kar sakta hai. Par battery dead ho toh kuch nahi karta.
hook.question: Is 'battery' ki power ko science ki language mein kya kehte hain jo isko work karne deti hai?

mental_model.intuition: Energy basically aapka 'bank balance' hai jisse aap 'work' khareedte ho.
mental_model.description: Bina energy ke koi kaam nahi ho sakta. Agar aapke paas energy hai, toh hi aap kisi object par force lagakar usko displace (work) kar sakte ho.

explanation:
Physics mein, energy aur work ka bahut close rishta hai. Asal mein, Energy is simply defined as the capacity to do work. Kisi bhi object ke paas agar kaam karne ki chamta (capacity) hai, toh hum kehte hain usme energy hai.

Jab aap koi work karte ho, toh energy ek body se doosri body mein transfer hoti hai. Jo object work karta hai (jaise ki aap agar dibbe ko dhakka de rahe ho), wo energy lose karta hai. Aur jis object par work kiya jata hai (wo dibba jo move kiya), wo energy gain karta hai.

Kyunki energy ek tareeke se work karne ki capacity hi hai, toh naturally energy ki measurement bhi usi unit mein ki jaati hai jismein work ki hoti hai. Isliye, energy ka SI unit bhi Joule (J) hi hai.

1 Joule energy us energy ko kehte hain jo exactly 1 Joule ka work karne ke liye kaafi ho. Kabhi kabhi baddi energy represent karne ke liye hum kilojoule (kJ) ka use karte hain. Yaad rakhna, `1 kJ = 1000 J`.

key_points.title: Definition of Energy
key_points.detail: Energy is the capacity to do work.

key_points.title: SI Unit
key_points.detail: The SI unit of energy is Joule (J). 1 kJ = 1000 J.

worked_example.problem: A machine does 5000 J of work. How much energy is consumed by the machine, assuming no energy is lost to heat or sound?

steps.narration: Energy consumed work done ke barabar hi hoti hai agar koi waste na ho.

worked_example.problem: If a person has 2 kJ of energy available, how many joules of work can they theoretically perform?

steps.narration: Pehle kilojoule ko joules mein convert karna hai kyunki standard unit Joule hai.

common_mistakes.title: Different units for work and energy
common_mistakes.explanation: Kuch students sochte hain ki work aur energy alag concepts hain toh unit alag honge. Par yaad rakhna, dono ka unit strictly Joule (J) hota hai.

recall_questions.q: What is the SI unit of energy?
Is energy a scalar or vector quantity?
How many Joules are there in 1 kilojoule?

oa_questions.question: What is the relationship between work and energy?
oa_questions.answer: Energy is the capacity to do work, and they share the same unit, the Joule (J).
oa_questions.approach: Recall the definition that binds them together.

oa_questions.question: An object having capability to do work is said to possess what?
oa_questions.approach: This is the direct definition of energy.
